Proof

\sketch Differentiate $| abla f|^2$ to obtain

\[ \partial _t| abla f|^2=-h( abla f, abla f)+2\langle abla k, abla f angle . \]

Combine this with the scalar-curvature and volume variation formulas, then integrate the $ abla k$, divergence, and Laplacian terms by parts against $e^{-f}dV$.
